name: Brothers' War
aliases: the war between Urza and Mishra
description: The decades-long war between Urza's Yotia and Mishra's Fallaji, ending at Argoth.

description_citations.text: "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At a second summit Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone; Urza reclaims it and declares war, starting the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: This was the start of the Brothers' War.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War erupts between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone, with ancient Thran machines used in battle.
timeline.quote: an epic war between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War spreads across Yotia and the Great Desert, and Mishra is changed by his experience in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Mishra's experience in Phyrexia seems to have changed him.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Double-crossings and sneak attacks between the brothers escalate into open war.
timeline.quote: soon resulting in open war

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex on Argoth, ending the Brothers' War and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex on a completely ravaged Argoth.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Almaaz is the only country that did not collapse in the wake of the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: The only country that didn't collapse in the wake of the War.

citation.text: "Terisian Isles", section "Almaaz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Fall of Sumifa in the Brothers' War, a new city of the same name is built almost 1300 years later.
timeline.quote: a new city of the same name was built after almost 1300 years.

citation.text: "Terisian Isles", section "Almaaz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers' battle becomes an all-consuming war that kills millions and strips Terisiare of resources.
timeline.quote: Millions of people were killed, slaughtered by one another and by the terrible machines of war.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra's kingdoms fight the Brothers' War, with Kroog falling and machines escalating the conflict for decades.
timeline.quote: It continued for decades until the fateful day at Argoth when the brothers met face to face at the head of their armies.

citation.text: "Urza", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast, the climax of the Brothers' War, lofted debris that blotted out the sun and created the Dark.
timeline.quote: The climax of the Brothers' War was the Sylex Blast , which lofted debris into the air blotting out the sun and creating The Dark .

citation.text: "The Dark", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Brothers' War the Ice Age approaches Sarpadia, bringing dwindling resources and fighting among allies.
timeline.quote: The changing climate results in dwindling resources and fighting amongst allies for survival.

citation.text: "Fallen Empires", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorine Relicbane urges remembering the horrors of the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: "I implore you not to forget the horrors of the past. You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!"

citation.text: Disenchant (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast ends the Brothers' War and alters Dominaria's climate, beginning the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: That war ended with the Sylex Blast , which was powerful enough to alter the planet's climate

citation.text: "Ice Age", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerda Äagesdotter says Lat-Nam's knowledge could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: "All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War."

citation.text: Lat-Nam's Legacy (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War scarred the land, and Ashnod marked bloodlines.
timeline.quote: The Brothers' War scarred the land, but Ashnod left her mark in the bloodlines of those she tortured.

citation.text: Ashnod's Altar (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Official Guide presents Urza's story from the explosive end of the Brothers' War to his discovery of the Thran Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: from the explosive end of the Brothers' War to his discovery of the Thran Mana Rig

citation.text: "Urza's Saga", section "Marketing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorine Relicbane pleads not to forget the horrors of the past or restart the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!

citation.text: Disenchant (Battle Royale Box Set, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerda says Lat-Nam's sages could not be protected from the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War.

citation.text: Lat-Nam's Legacy (Coldsnap Theme Decks, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast, detonated by Urza in Argoth at the climax of the Brothers' War, creates the first known rift.
timeline.quote: detonated by Urza in Argoth, which created the first known rift

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Causes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The war between Urza and Mishra makes Dominaria itself a casualty.
timeline.quote: the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominaria itself a casualty of war

citation.text: Strip Mine (From the Vault: Exiled, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi uses the Temporal Anchor in Urza's Tower to travel back to the Brothers' War to learn how to fire the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: to travel back in time to the Brothers' War .

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Teferi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A feud between Urza and Mishra erupts into an all-out war that sets the future of the plane and Multiverse in motion.
timeline.quote: what started as a feud between Urza and Mishra erupted into an all-out war that set into motion the future of the plane and Multiverse itself.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final conflict the ultimate event ends the war and changes Dominaria forever.
timeline.quote: Final Conflict – We observe the ultimate event that ends the war and changes Dominaria forever.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War", section "Set details". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Peace talks at Kroog end disastrously and mark the official start of the Brothers' War; the phyrexian demon enters Dominaria as Gix.
timeline.quote: a new peace conference in Kroog also ends disastrously and marks the official beginning of the Brothers' War .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the aftermath, Argive, Yotia, Yumok, Malpiri and Korlis collapse and the Dark Age begins.
timeline.quote: Almaaz is the only state on Terisiare to remain intact. The Dark Age begins.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Titania briefly becomes an avatar of Gaea during the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: briefly became an avatar of Gaea during the Brothers' War

citation.text: "Worldsoul", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra wage a savage war on each other, devastating Dominaria and plunging it into an ice age.
timeline.quote: the brothers waged a savage war against each other, devastating Dominaria and plunging the plane into an ice age.

citation.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
